import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(8,6))
# side view
ax1.set_xlim(0,1.0); ax1.set_ylim(0,0.55)
ax1.set_title("side view: chassis, wheels, ladder, hopper")
# frame
ax1.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.15,0.30),0.65,0.12, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax1.text(0.45,0.36,"frame", ha='center')
# wheels
for x in [0.25,0.70]:
    ax1.add_patch(plt.Circle((x,0.15),0.10, fill=False, linewidth=2))
    ax1.text(x,0.15,"wheel D0.2", ha='center', fontsize=8)
# ladder front
ax1.plot([0.15,0.02],[0.32,0.10], linewidth=3)
ax1.text(0.03,0.22,"ladder", fontsize=8)
# hopper
ax1.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.5,0.42),0.25,0.08, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax1.text(0.62,0.46,"hopper", ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_aspect('equal'); ax1.set_xlabel("length m"); ax1.set_ylabel("height m")
# top view
ax2.set_xlim(0,1.0); ax2.set_ylim(0,0.6)
ax2.set_title("top view stowed vs deployed track")
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.05,0.15),0.9,0.30, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax2.text(0.5,0.3,"stowed 0.9x0.45 inside 1.0x0.5 box", ha='center', fontsize=8)
for x,y in [(0.2,0.15),(0.7,0.15),(0.2,0.45),(0.7,0.45)]:
    ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x-0.07,y-0.05),0.14,0.10, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax2.text(0.5,0.08,"deployed track widens by fold arms", ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_aspect('equal'); ax2.set_xlabel("length m"); ax2.set_ylabel("width m")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("sketch.png")
